title: Hoeffding's lemma
statement:
Let $p \in [0,1]$ and let $h \in \bbr$ be arbitrary. Then
\[
  \log\!\bigl((1-p) + p\,e^{h}\bigr) \;\le\; p\,h + \frac{h^{2}}{8}.
\]
replaced:
For $p \in [0,1]$ and any $h \in \mathbb{R}$,
\[
  \ln\!\bigl((1-p) + p\,e^h\bigr) \;\le\; p\,h + \frac{h^2}{8}.
\]
This specializes the Bernoulli moment-generating-function bound from
\texttt{bernoulli\_mgf\_bound} by substituting $\eta = -h$.
